title: Mars Meaning
overview: Mars describes action, desire, anger, courage, conflict, heat, pursuit, boundaries, and the way a person uses force. It shows how effort is mobilized, how a person fights for what matters, and where raw energy needs direction.
cycle: Mars usually spends about six to seven weeks in a sign, though retrograde cycles can keep it in one sign for several months. Its sign describes action style and conflict style; its house shows where drive, friction, and initiative concentrate.

signs.body: Mars in Aries acts quickly, directly, and with strong initiative. This placement has clean ignition, but needs a worthy outlet so courage does not become needless conflict.
Mars in Taurus acts slowly but persistently. This placement builds momentum through endurance, but can become immovable when anger has nowhere honest to go.
Mars in Gemini acts through words, ideas, movement, and quick decisions. This placement is mentally sharp and versatile, but needs focus so energy does not scatter.
Mars in Cancer acts protectively and emotionally. This placement fights for home, family, and safety, but must watch indirect anger when needs are not named.
Mars in Leo acts with pride, warmth, creativity, and dramatic force. This placement needs a stage for courage and a purpose that lets effort feel personal.
Mars in Virgo acts through precision, improvement, service, and practical skill. This placement is effective when focused on useful work, but can turn heat into criticism.
Mars in Libra acts through strategy, negotiation, aesthetics, and the pursuit of fairness. This placement fights best when it knows what it wants and stops outsourcing the decision.
Mars in Scorpio acts with depth, intensity, patience, and controlled force. This placement can endure pressure and move with precision, but must watch control as a defense.
Mars in Sagittarius acts through conviction, movement, risk, and the pursuit of truth. This placement needs a horizon, but must make sure belief is embodied in action.
Mars in Capricorn acts with discipline, strategy, endurance, and respect for results. This placement can build real power through patience and directed effort.
Mars in Aquarius acts through principle, innovation, independence, and group-minded change. This placement needs a cause and the freedom to move differently.
Mars in Pisces acts through intuition, compassion, imagination, and subtle timing. This placement needs spiritual or creative purpose, plus boundaries strong enough to keep energy from leaking.
